ii) QUASH THE AWARD PASSED BY THE R3 AUTHORITY IN RESPECT OF THE PETITIONERS LAND MEASURING 23 GUNTAS IN SY. NO. 7/3 OF SHEEGEPAALYA VILLAGE, KASABA NORTH HOBLI, TUMKUR TALUK WHICH IS PRODUCED DD 4.10.2023 BEARING NO.
SLAOSR.(RU.RA.RAILWAY) 09/2020-21 ANNEXURE-L. iii) DIRECTING THE R3 AUTHORITY TO PASS A FRESH AWARD BY TAKING INTO CONSIDERATION THE VALUATION PREPARED / ASSESSED FOR THE PLANTATION IN THE AFORESAID PETITIONERS 23 GUNTAS OF LAND IN SY. NO. 7/3 BY THE FOREST AND HORTICULTURE DEPARTMENT AS PER ANNEXURE-K.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

This writ petition is filed for following reliefs:
"i) Issue an appropriate order or direction to the respondent no.3 authority to re-do the JMC Survey Report by taking into consideration the plantation in the petitioner's land measuring 23 guntas in Sy.no.7/3 of Sheegepalya village, Kasaba North Hobli,
Tumakur Taluk.
ii) Issue an appropriate writ of certiorari or any other writ or order quashing the award passed by the Respondent No.3 authority in respect of the Petitioner's land measuring 23 Guntas in Sy.no.7/3 of Sheegepaalya village, Kasba North Hobli,
Tumkur Taluk, which is produced at Annexure-L dated 4.10.2023 bearing no.SLA OSR (TU.Railway):09 /2020-21;

iii) Issue an appropriate writ or direction or order directing the Respondent No.3 authority to pass a fresh award by taking into consideration the valuation prepared/assessed for the plantation in the aforesaid petitioner's 23 Guntas of land in Sy.no.7/3 by the Forest and Horticulture Department as per Annexure-K, etc.

sentences.text:
2. Sri Kishan G.S., learned counsel for petitioner submitted that petitioner was owner of land measuring 23 guntas in Sy.no.7/3, situated at Sheegepalya village, Kasaba Hobli, Tumakuru Taluk,
which was acquired by respondent no.3 for Tumakuru Rayadurga Railway Project.
It was submitted that at time of conducting JMC Survey, plantations namely, Mango, Neem and Teakwood trees were being left out of consideration.
Therefore, petitioner submitted representations to respondent no.3 on 09.10.2020, 16.01.2023 and 24.01.2023 respectively.
In response to same, petitioner was informed that report of competent authority at Annexure -G would be followed.

Subsequent report of surveyor indicated existence of that total of 16 mango trees, 05 teakwood trees and 05 Neem trees grown on petitioner's land which were valued by Horticulture and Forest Department as per Annexure-K.

Despite same, respondent proceeded to pass award on 04.10.2023 at Annexure-L.
Assailing same for purpose of redoing it
, petitioner has approached this Court.

3. On other hand, Sri Yogesh D. Naik, learned AGA appearing for respondents no.1 to 3 and Sri S.V.
Desai, learned counsel for respondent no.4 sought to oppose writ petition.

It NC: 2023:KHC:44715 was contended that since award was already passed, petitioner had efficacious remedy of urging all contentions regarding entitlement of higher compensation by filing application for reference under Section 64 of of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (RFCTLARR Act, 2013)

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (RFCTLARR Act, 2013)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: , therefore submitted that petitioner was not entitled for any relief.

4. Heard learned counsel and perused writ petition record.
5.
From above submission, acquisition of petitioner's land by respondent authority for Railway project is not in dispute.

While petitioner claims that there were valuable trees on his land which was noted at time of Survey, but ignored while passing award, respondents contend that same can be agitated by petitioner in a duly instituted reference petition.

Since award is passed on 04.10.2023, it would be open for petitioner to file reference application under Section 64 of RFCTLARR Act, 2013 by urging all contentions urged herein.
6.

Perusal of Section 64 of RFCTLARR Act, 2013 would avail consideration for enhancement of compensation on all counts, including failure to consider value of trees etc. on land NC:
2023:KHC:44715 acquired.
Thus petitioners would be at liberty to file application for reference.
In case, petitioners file application, Reference Court shall consider same and pass appropriate award.
With above observations writ petition is disposed of.

Sd/-
JUDGE Psg*
